defects.summary: search_tasks builds SQL by string formatting from the request parameter q.
user_tasks returns any user's tasks to any signed-in caller because it never compares user_id with the caller.
download_attachment joins the request parameter name onto the upload folder with no containment check (path traversal).
The pull request title is interpolated into a run step that has secrets in the job env, and a third-party action is pinned to a moving branch.
rm -rf on an unquoted SCRATCH_DIR that expands to /* when the variable is unset or empty.
A failed job is released back to the queue on every error with no attempt cap or backoff, so it retries forever.
Task number is read as MAX+1 and inserted without a transaction or unique constraint, so concurrent creates can get the same number.
Label insert errors are swallowed and the handler still returns 201, leaving a task without its labels.
Keyset page query uses id >= cursor, so the last item of one page is repeated as the first item of the next.
Token expiry adds minutes to a seconds timestamp, so tokens last 60 seconds instead of 60 minutes.
Task titles are written through innerHTML without escaping (stored script injection).
The example env file the deploy script copies to .env ships a known default administrator password.

known_extras.title: A bearer token with a non-ASCII character gets a 500 instead of a 401
A negative Content-Length skips the JSON body size limit and reads the body without bound
A negative Content-Length skips the upload size limit and reads the body without bound
Webhook URL is checked only for a scheme prefix, so internal addresses are accepted
Webhook delivery posts to any host with no check of the target address
A non-scalar assignee_id in task creation gets a 500 instead of a 422
Browser preflight requests get 501 because the server has no OPTIONS handler
Search responses can arrive out of order and overwrite the newest results
Registration checks for an existing email then inserts, so a concurrent duplicate hits the unique constraint with no handler and gets a 500 instead of a 409
The workflow grants pull-requests write permission although no step uses the pull request API
